scope: native implementation/build preparation; no real XPC/AX/system acceptance

scenarios: application identity is exact and bounded
discovery returns public identity without input or a retained gate
prepare binds the exact approved path and digest
gate is nonqueued and close releases it once
Unicode batches preserve units and private sequence prevents replay
unknown lease cannot cancel the prepared target
target changes before input refuse and after a batch preserve partial
ambiguous posting closes the lease and cannot replay
monotonic expiry and backwards time stop unused batches
disconnect closes a lease without posting
slow capture cannot prepare a future target
concurrent duplicate batches post once after rechecking
idle lease automatically releases the global gate
real private file gate excludes a second instance and refuses aliases
